summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True when a terminal (buffers the control) and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a legacy branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, skipped on win32), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows only). Not run: per instructions, no tests, mypy, or Black were executed. Nothing committed.
